# ==========================================================================
# Host DMA over NoC — Network-3 streaming connections (AUTO-GENERATED by write_hdl).
# Moves the per-vFPGA host DMA stream off fabric SLLs onto the hardened NoC.
# Two DIAGONAL hub-shared fabrics (mirrors the P2P block, but source-i always
# targets the SAME vFPGA i, so group g pairs only with hub g, not any-to-any):
#   h2c: axis_host_in_ul[i] (static, SLR0) -> inst_hnoc_h2c_nmu_g (SLR0)
#        -> NoC -> inst_hnoc_h2c_nsu_g (SLR1/2) -> demux -> user_wrapper[i].sink
#   c2h: user_wrapper[i].src -> inst_hnoc_c2h_nmu_g (SLR1/2)
#        -> NoC -> inst_hnoc_c2h_nsu_g (SLR0) -> demux -> axis_host_out_ul[i]
# tdest = vFPGA id; each hub NSU is tagged with its group's tdest RANGE.
# Endpoints are RM static cells (in inst_dynamic); create_noc_connection runs at
# synthesis_pre. Positional-wildcard get_noc_interfaces (leading *) — a -filter
# NAME=~ matches nothing for NoC interfaces.
#
# TILE PLACEMENT (device-verified 2026-09-18, all exist, disjoint from the P2P
# endpoints at NMU Y8/Y13 + NSU Y12/Y17):
#   host-side (SLR0, CRs X5/X7 — clear of CPM5 at X0/X1 and PS9): NoC rows Y2/Y4
#   vFPGA-side (SLR1 rows / SLR2 rows): NoC row Y9 (SLR1) / Y14 (SLR2)
# RISK: host-side SLR0 tiles must not collide with CPM5/PS9/shell NoC usage in the
# real static — validate_noc at the N=2 build is the gate.
# ==========================================================================
{% if cnfg.fdev == 'v80' and cnfg.en_host_noc == 1 and cnfg.n_reg > 1 %}
{% set M  = [cnfg.n_reg, 4] | min %}
{% set K  = (cnfg.n_reg + M - 1) // M %}
{% set h2c_nmu_loc = ['NOC_NMU512_X2Y2','NOC_NMU512_X3Y2','NOC_NMU512_X2Y4','NOC_NMU512_X3Y4'] %}
{% set h2c_nsu_loc = ['NOC_NSU512_X0Y9','NOC_NSU512_X1Y9','NOC_NSU512_X2Y14','NOC_NSU512_X3Y14'] %}
{% set c2h_nmu_loc = ['NOC_NMU512_X0Y9','NOC_NMU512_X1Y9','NOC_NMU512_X2Y14','NOC_NMU512_X3Y14'] %}
{% set c2h_nsu_loc = ['NOC_NSU512_X2Y2','NOC_NSU512_X3Y2','NOC_NSU512_X2Y4','NOC_NSU512_X3Y4'] %}
# ---- h2c: host-side NMU (SLR0) -> vFPGA-side NSU (SLR1/2), diagonal g->g ----
{% for g in range(M) %}
set hnoc_h2c_nmu_{{ g }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_hnoc_h2c_nmu_{{ '%02d' % g }}/S_AXIS_nmu]
set_property LOCATION {{ h2c_nmu_loc[g] }} $hnoc_h2c_nmu_{{ g }}
set hnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ g }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_hnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ '%02d' % g }}/M_AXIS_nsu]
set_property TDEST_ID {{ '0x%X' % (g * K) }}:{{ '0x%X' % ([g * K + K - 1, cnfg.n_reg - 1] | min) }} $hnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ g }}
set_property LOCATION {{ h2c_nsu_loc[g] }} $hnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ g }}
create_noc_connection -source $hnoc_h2c_nmu_{{ g }} -target $hnoc_h2c_nsu_{{ g }}
{% endfor %}
# ---- c2h: vFPGA-side NMU (SLR1/2) -> host-side NSU (SLR0), diagonal g->g ----
{% for g in range(M) %}
set hnoc_c2h_nmu_{{ g }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_hnoc_c2h_nmu_{{ '%02d' % g }}/S_AXIS_nmu]
set_property LOCATION {{ c2h_nmu_loc[g] }} $hnoc_c2h_nmu_{{ g }}
set hnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ g }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_hnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ '%02d' % g }}/M_AXIS_nsu]
set_property TDEST_ID {{ '0x%X' % (g * K) }}:{{ '0x%X' % ([g * K + K - 1, cnfg.n_reg - 1] | min) }} $hnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ g }}
set_property LOCATION {{ c2h_nsu_loc[g] }} $hnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ g }}
create_noc_connection -source $hnoc_c2h_nmu_{{ g }} -target $hnoc_c2h_nsu_{{ g }}
{% endfor %}
{% endif %}
